summary: Standardizes workbench controls with an original SVG icon family and a searchable icon catalog.
warning: Installed post packages, saved revisions, controller output and local storage remain compatible. This release changes control pictures and the app favicon; existing labels and machining operations retain their meaning.

checklist.schema: App release 0.0.698 follows the separate CAD release 0.0.697. UPID, post schema, engine API, package and saved-document versions are unchanged. The typed icon catalog is a UI asset contract.
checklist.events: No post execution events, simulation events or WebMCP operation events change. Icon replacement retains the existing control handlers and accessibility state.
checklist.capabilities: No machine/post capability changes. The original SVG family includes distinct CAD operations, geometry, navigation, files, storage and status symbols. The standalone searchable catalog previews assets; it does not invoke machining operations.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No output generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, controller file or feed behavior changes. Output still requires the existing saved revision and complete active machine package.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No package installation, saved revision, browser cache or folder adapter changes. No migration or cleanup is performed. The icon catalog does not read or write workbench storage.
checklist.verification: Integrated onto published CAD checkpoint 6e2113f after CAD 0.0.697. All 286 original icon usages, eight dynamic slots and 17 feature kinds resolve; 1,982 inventory rows reconcile with zero gaps. Node 24.22.0 passes all 115 UI/geometry files / 1,161 tests with two workers, including region selection and physical depth controls. Six icon/catalog/accessibility tests, exact icon geometry, integration-map parity, CAD control-text preservation, release and production build/documentation/source checks pass. Luna reviewers exercised the earlier actual app and independently reviewed the latest region/depth integration boundary. CAD domain, actual help drawings, gear diagrams, depth geometry/rust colors, picking/navigation/version guards, controller and saved-data behavior match the target. Exact results are in docs/design/icon-verification.md. No app server was started or changed for this update.

publicNotes.summary: Recognize workbench actions through a consistent original icon family.
changes: CAD feature icons distinguish material addition and removal, rounded and beveled edges, sketches, solids, patterns and mirroring.
File, editing, simulation, storage, navigation and status controls use matching SVG metrics and inherit their control colors.
The icon catalog provides searchable previews at toolbar and tree sizes on light and dark backgrounds.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed posts, saved revisions, machine packages, storage and controller output remain compatible.
publicNotes.action: Use the existing control labels and tooltips to identify actions. Icon pictures have changed; their operations retain the same checks.
